title: GTPv2: refresh IEs name according to latest release

notes.body: Should we keep gtpv2.upd_source_port_number as a hidden filed for backward compatibility? Maybe this field is never used and not worth worrying, just thinking aloud.
Hidden field seems to be a bad choice according to guidelines, but it might be valid here? However Port is not that common IE what I seen...
OK, maybe this is not worth the trouble. I'm not a GTPv2 user myself so I cannot judge.
